stories.title: EN DIRECT - Violences sexuelles dans le périscolaire à Paris : «Le nombre de victimes est intolérable, inacceptable», souligne Anne Hidalgo

en.title: LIVE - Sexual violence in Paris out-of-school activities: "The number of victims is intolerable, unacceptable," Anne Hidalgo emphasizes
en.summary: Former Paris mayor Anne Hidalgo testified before the Senate about sexual violence in out-of-school programs, acknowledging the number of victims as unacceptable while defending measures taken by her administration, though she conceded they were insufficient.

stories.title: "Nos institutions ont failli", estime Anne Hidalgo à propos des violences sexuelles dans le périscolaire à Paris

en.title: "Our institutions failed," Anne Hidalgo says regarding sexual violence in Paris out-of-school activities
en.summary: Former Paris mayor Anne Hidalgo was questioned before the Senate about sexual violence in out-of-school programs. She and her successor face criminal investigations following complaints from multiple families.

stories.title: Le Pentagone reconnaît une "pénurie" de munitions liée à la guerre en Iran

en.title: The Pentagon acknowledges a "shortage" of ammunition linked to the war in Iran
en.summary: The U.S. Defense Department document confirms that munitions expenses from the "Epic Fury" operation caused a deficit in strategic inventories and revealed bottlenecks in defense industries.

stories.title: Devant la commission du Sénat sur le périscolaire, Anne Hidalgo reconnait : «Nos institutions ont failli dans la protection de nos enfants»

en.title: Before the Senate commission on out-of-school activities, Anne Hidalgo acknowledges: "Our institutions failed in protecting our children"
en.summary: Former Socialist Paris mayor Anne Hidalgo and her successor testified before the Senate, which is investigating sexual and other violence in out-of-school programs across France. Both officials face criminal investigations.

stories.title: Anne Hidalgo fait part de ses « regrets immenses » à propos des violences dans le périscolaire à Paris

en.title: Anne Hidalgo expresses "immense regrets" regarding violence in Paris after-school programs
en.summary: The former mayor of Paris testified before the Senate during an investigation into sexual violence in after-school programs in France, expressing regrets and stating that institutions failed.

stories.title: Guerre en Iran : le Pentagone reconnaît une «pénurie» de munitions et chiffre les affrontements à 33 milliards de dollars

en.title: War in Iran: Pentagon acknowledges ammunition "shortage" and estimates confrontations at 33 billion dollars
en.summary: The U.S. Defense Department released a report confirming a shortage in strategic ammunition inventories following operations in Iran, valued at 33 billion dollars.

stories.title: Le mariage de Donald Trump Jr a été en grande partie financé par un oligarque proche de Vladimir Poutine, révèle un magazine américain d'investigation

en.title: Donald Trump Jr's wedding was largely financed by an oligarch close to Vladimir Putin, reveals an American investigative magazine
en.summary: An investigation reveals that Donald Trump Jr's wedding was substantially funded by Umar Kremlev, an oligarch with ties to Vladimir Putin, potentially affecting ongoing Ukraine-Russia negotiations.

stories.title: Un drone abattu pour la première fois par l’Otan dans le ciel de la Lituanie, l’origine de l’engin encore inconnue

en.title: A drone shot down for the first time by NATO in Lithuanian airspace, the origin of the aircraft still unknown
en.summary: NATO shot down a drone for the first time in Lithuanian airspace using fighter jets, with its origin remaining unclear, amid intensified Russian military operations in Europe.

stories.title: "J'attends des excuses de la maire" : Anne Hidalgo et Emmanuel Grégoire attendus au tournant devant le Sénat sur les violences dans le périscolaire

en.title: "I expect an apology from the mayor": Anne Hidalgo and Emmanuel Grégoire under scrutiny before the Senate over violence in after-school programs
en.summary: The former and current mayors of Paris are being questioned by a Senate information committee investigating how cases of violence in after-school programs were reported and handled.

stories.title: Le Pentagone reconnaît pour la première fois une pénurie de munitions pour l’armée américaine, du fait de la guerre en Iran

en.title: Pentagon acknowledges ammunition shortage for US military due to war in Iran
en.summary: The US Defense Department has reported a shortage in strategic ammunition inventories following military operations in Iran, contradicting earlier statements about unlimited munitions availability.

stories.title: Espace : les États-Unis confirment pour la première fois avoir déployé des armes en orbite

en.title: Space: the United States confirms for the first time having deployed weapons in orbit
en.summary: The US Space Force announced it possesses armed space control systems designed to protect American forces against hostile actions. The deployment is justified by increasing military capabilities from China and Russia in space.

stories.title: « Nous attendons des excuses » : rattrapés par le scandale du périscolaire, Anne Hidalgo et Patrick Bloche sommés de répondre aux familles devant le Sénat

en.title: "We await apologies": Caught in school program scandal, Anne Hidalgo and Patrick Bloche summoned to answer families before Senate
en.summary: The former Paris mayor and her ex-deputy in charge of education are being questioned by a Senate investigative commission regarding physical and sexual violence against students in after-school programs.

stories.title: La folle rentrée du New space français des lanceurs

en.title: The mad start of French new space small launch vehicle sector
en.summary: New French small rocket manufacturers are competing in the emerging launch vehicle market, with several companies presenting updates at a space summit.

stories.title: Airbus ouvre un centre de livraison à Toulouse pour accélérer l'envol de l'A321NEO

en.title: Airbus opens delivery center in Toulouse to accelerate A321NEO takeoff
en.summary: Airbus has inaugurated a second delivery center spanning 35,000 square meters in Toulouse to increase production rates for its single-aisle aircraft.

stories.title: Sorégies mise 200 millions d’euros dans le projet de retenues d’eau de Next Step, « le futur de l’hydroélectricité »

en.title: Sorégies invests 200 million euros in Next Step's water retention project, "the future of hydroelectricity"
en.summary: Sorégies, an electricity and gas distributor, is investing 200 million euros in Next Step Energy, a startup developing new hydroelectric assets to provide grid flexibility as solar and wind power increase.

stories.title: Inflation à 2,4% : les carburants font remonter l’addition

en.title: Inflation at 2.4%: fuel prices drive the increase
en.summary: Annual inflation reached 2.4% in August compared to 2.1% in July, with petroleum products surging 28.7% year-on-year, while non-energy prices excluding fresh products and public tariffs showed slower growth.

stories.title: OPINION. « Pour MBS, l'heure de vérité a sonné » (Michel Santi)

en.title: OPINION. "For MBS, the moment of truth has arrived" (Michel Santi)
en.summary: The Strait of Hormuz faces closure threats, the Bab el-Mandeb is controlled by Houthis, and financial deficits are mounting, presenting challenges for a regional leader seeking unilateral decision-making authority.
